text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems as if it was only a short moment
ago that I walked through
those Tracen
Academy gates for the first time, yet
today marks yet
another beginning!

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
How do you do,
<username>? I am the
chief
trainer of the team you will be
joining from this moment on.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how much pep I've got left to
keep up with all these
ambitious runners at
this age... I do hope that I'm able to impart
all
the insight an up-and-coming assistant
trainer could need.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now that's the spirit! I'm expecting
great things from you. I've
actually been
keeping an eye on all your efforts. You're
here for a
very good reason!

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Enough chatter, though. I want you to
meet a real go-getter. Let's go
outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
New trainers are placed under the
guidance of a veteran. The idea is
to help
out and gain experience as a team
assistant trainer for a
certain period of
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This team's trainer has been at it for years
and is quite renowned. The
time has come
for me to meet her newest trainee.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... I've finished with the regimen you passed me this morning, Trainer. What should I do next?

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well done out there, Bell. I had some
partner running planned for you
next, but
before that, would you mind? This is our
new assistant
trainer we spoke of the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well done out there, Bell. I had some
partner running planned for you
next, but
before that, would you mind? This is our
new assistant
trainer we spoke of the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Good day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes... Um... A pleasure to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to formally introduce you,
Assistant Trainer. This is
Bell—Mejiro
Dober. She is our team's precious star.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to formally introduce you,
Assistant Trainer. This is
Bell—Mejiro
Dober. She is our team's precious star.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I can only imagine that she will be the final
runner under my own
guidance. I've
become quite the old lady, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just listen to me prattle on. Don't
worry about a thing, Bell. I
don't plan on
going anywhere just yet, so let's bring a
smile back,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I'm here for some partner
running. Are you all ready?

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! Thank you for taking the time, Air
Groove. Are you prepared
to start. Bell?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm ready whenever you are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober and Air Groove take off
down the track as a pair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is quite the respectable
training partner. Known as the
"Empress,"
she's followed in her mother's footsteps,
having taken
home the second Oaks win
for her family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has not made her debut yet,
but is seemingly having
little problem
keeping up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, not bad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The runner displays an important sign of a
champion in the
making—an energetic
form that begets great speeds. But that's
not
all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Keep going, keep goooing! Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without even considering giving up, she
advances ever forward. I'm
very impressed
with her show of willpower and
competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... Thank you... very much!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. I must say, Dober—that
was quite the showing. Very
impressive
speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But even so... I've still much room to
improve my positioning and
timing. I
wasn't able to overtake you even once...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I don't yield my lead quite so
readily. Still, I could
definitely feel your
presence creeping ever closer. You're
certainly
paired with an excellent trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm still so very weak, but I have noticed at
least a bit of
improvement. I owe all of
that to my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: Good, good! That was a wonderful run.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this? Is that a twinkle in your
eyes that I see? I just knew
that you would
be one to understand.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Bell just amazing? She's practically
overflowing with talent.

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I do hope I can stand by her and help her
realize all of her wildest
dreams, but I'm
not sure I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? I still have some energy, so
would it be okay if I
accompanied Air
Groove for some extra training?

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well now, it looks like someone is feeling
extra motivated recently! I
don't see why
not, if it's just one more lap or so. Take it a
bit slower,
all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will. Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Chief Trainer
text_block_list.text: As for us, why don't we start cleaning up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend a bit more time helping out the
chief trainer, thinking the
whole while
about how lucky I was to be able to
witness such fine
running from Mejiro
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What is—
Ah.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Ryan! Please look over here, Mejiro
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan, you had another terrific race
the other day! What do you
have to say to
all your fans who are looking forward to
your next
race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm so thankful for all your support!
I'll keep training hard to
make sure I live
up to all your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We'll go back this way. Let's go, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All right...
